name: Pickler
role: Dakota legislator; moved capital removal to Pierre and woman suffrage
mentions: The motion of Legislator Pickler for the relocating of the capitol from Bismarck to Pierre will be called up this afternoon, and we predict will not become a law. The southern delegation is not…
